<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <send event="ping" namelist="x">
        <content>payload</content>
      </send>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="ping" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

notes: `<content>` supplies the complete payload; `namelist` and `<param>` build a key/value payload, so the two forms cannot be combined
